questions.question: Like Psalm 14, what does the fool say in his heart?
What did God look down from heaven to see?
options: Whether the scattered exiles would return back to the land
Whether the harvest of the fields would be great that year
Whether there were any who understood and sought God
Whether the king would win the great battle that was coming
questions.answer: Whether there were any who understood and sought God

questions.question: The psalm longs that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion.
The fool says in his heart, 'There is no _____.'
They have all fallen away; together they have become _____.
